## Sep 20 Results: The Data Speaks Volumes

Let me break down yesterday's performance by the numbers. We posted an 11-4 record with 73.3% accuracy across 15 picks. That's 2.75 wins for every loss—a ratio that puts us well above break-even thresholds. When you're hitting at nearly three-quarters accuracy, the statistical significance is undeniable.

## Breaking Down the Misses

Two misses came on 50% probability picks (Astros, Rangers)—essentially coin flips. When your confidence interval is that narrow, variance plays a bigger role. The model performs optimally when edge probability exceeds 55%. Our 60%+ picks went 8-1 (88.9% accuracy). That's where the real value lives.

## Sep 21 Preview: Tomorrow's Top Pick

Looking ahead to September 21st, the model has identified Toronto Blue Jays at Baltimore Orioles as the top value play. The Jays register at 54% win probability—a modest edge, but an edge nonetheless. The pitching matchup features Trey Yesavage for Toronto against Shane Baz for Baltimore.
